# Team Offsite in Lisbon

A one-page proposal for a 3-day team offsite in Lisbon this fall.

## Goals
- Team bonding
- Planning next year
- Shipping the demo

## Agenda
- Day 1: arrivals, walking tour, welcome dinner in Alfama
- Day 2: planning workshops, demo hack, sunset sail

## Why Lisbon
- Direct flights for everyone
- Great food, walkable, sunny in October
